title: Man dies of injuries from police shooting
article: ? A 48-year-old gun-wielding man shot by Peel Regional Police officers last week at his Mississauga home has died.
The Special Investigations Unit said the man, whose identity has not been released, died early yesterday in hospital from gunshot-related injuries sustained in the incident last Friday.
Police had been called to the home on after a caller reported gunshots. The man was shot when he ignored warnings not to move.
